notes.title: v1.2.1 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,

Just dropped a small update for the game, I've switched the main interaction button from Z to E. 
However, Z can still be used for interactions.

Kind Regards,
Nuno "Omega Leo" Diogo

notes.title: Steam Next Fest October 2023
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that Schrodinger's Code will be part of the October 2023 Steam Next Fest 🥳
Come join us starting October 09th for the first public demo release of the game!
